summary: This RFC is an official status report on protocol parameter values in the Internet family: network numbers, well-known ports, protocol types, and version numbers. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 923.

eli5.summary: Computers need agreed numbers for things, like which door to knock on for which service. This was the official list, now replaced by later lists.

questions: what were the assigned numbers in 1984
where are well known port numbers listed
